stem.optics.predict_no_penalty: Being wrong costs nothing and is the useful case — a corrected prediction is remembered better than a number you were simply shown.
stem.optics.predict_wrong: ✗ Not what happens — which is the useful case
stem.optics.predict_why_tir: No refracted ray exists: sinθ₂ would exceed 1, so the light is trapped. That can only happen going into the LESS dense medium, past the critical angle.
stem.optics.predict_why_under: The light refracts through because θ₁ is still under the critical angle for this pair. Raise the angle and it will eventually flip.
stem.optics.predict_why_no_crit: There is no critical angle here: n₁ ≤ n₂, so light entering the denser medium always refracts, at any angle.
stem.optics.i_observed_that_because_the_: I observed that ... because the diagram/calculation showed ...
